description: This file is an abstract base test class for validating persistence actors related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It sets up constants, mock configurations, and utility methods for subclasses to test policy persistence functionality.

classes.name: PersistenceActorTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for unit testing persistence actors related to policies in Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test configuration data before any tests are run.

methods.name: createDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a DittoHeaders instance with specified JSON schema version and authorization subjects.

methods.name: createPolicyWithRandomId
methods.description: Creates a policy with a randomly generated ID for testing.

methods.name: createPolicyWithId
methods.description: Creates a policy with a specified ID for testing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the test environment with a custom configuration.

methods.name: setUpBase
methods.description: Initializes the test environment using default test configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Performs the actual initialization of ActorSystem and test probes.

methods.name: tearDownBase
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: disableLogging
methods.description: Disables logging output for a clean test run, can be toggled for debugging.
